Melantha wants to travel to Arkeron's realm to save Locket, her fallen friend and founding member of [[The Young Wolves]]. 
The very first order of business is to have a body to put Locket into, because without a vessel he is just a soul in a rock.

In order to reach Arkeron's Realm of The Cognition Nexus, you have to travel through the Infinite Corridor. They key to reaching this place is to first discover how Arkeron first became a deity. 
- (SPOILERS): Arkeron became a god using the soulstone of Atom, an alternate version of Adam where he became a warforged and fused with Locket. He became the Atomic God, and when his soulstone was brought to Terra-Nova it was given to Arkeron by Ivys Arthur in a dream that occured through an incidental time travel, due to his use of the Temporal Keystone.
- After discovering this you are able to learn that Arkeron was created through a self fulfilling time loop, a consequence of Ivys Arthur and Kairos' meddling in the timeline at the Timekeeper's tower.

After having a powerful dream mentioned above ([[Ivys Arkeron Dream]]), Ivys has Locket's soulstone. Now what we require is a new body.
There are many options for new bodies, but the major 2 are a new warforged body crafted by Dietrich and Lonnithan, or a druidforged body made by Ryfon.
- [[LocketWarforged.png]]
- [[LocketDruidforged.png]]

The mechanical differences between these 2 are that the druidforged can cast speak with animals at will, while warforged gains advantage on rolls working with machines.
